lead: Ancient mountain energy, four ways. Shilajit, ashwagandha, tongkat ali and sea moss in one capsule — a concentrated adaptogen stack to support natural energy, stamina, focus and drive, without the crash of caffeine.

science.title: Four ancient tonics, one capsule
science.text: Real, lasting energy isn't just caffeine. Shilajit is a mineral-rich resin from high mountains, prized for centuries for vitality and fulvic-acid-driven cellular energy. We stack it with ashwagandha (the classic adaptogen for stress balance and stamina), tongkat ali (traditionally used for drive and performance) and mineral-rich sea moss — high-ratio extracts that work together for steady, caffeine-free energy.

format.title: Extracts, not fillers
format.text: These are concentrated extracts — shilajit 30:1, tongkat ali 300:1 — so a single small capsule delivers a meaningful dose of all four adaptogens, with nothing padding it out.
list: — 1 capsule = shilajit + ashwagandha + tongkat ali + sea moss

absorb.title: Energy your body adapts into
absorb.lead: Adaptogens help your body cope with stress and stay balanced, while shilajit's fulvic minerals support energy at the cellular level.

facts.side_text: 400 mg shilajit (30:1) plus 100 mg each of ashwagandha (30:1), sea moss (20:1) and tongkat ali (300:1) in a vegetable capsule — no caffeine, no fillers. Made in the USA — 30 capsules.
facts.warning: If you are pregnant or nursing, under 18, or have a medical condition or take medication, consult a physician before use.
